Explanation:  
The question requires identifying the No. 1 song on the Billboard Hot 100 exactly 30 years after John F. Kennedy’s inauguration (January 20, 1991). The Ground Truth Answer correctly identifies this date and provides "Love Will Never Do (Without You)" by Janet Jackson as the correct song. The Predicted Answer gives "All the Man That I Need" by Whitney Houston as the No. 1 song, which is incorrect based on the ground truth. The substance and vital fact—the correct song—are not present in the Predicted Answer.
